description: Replace the HTML at a previously shared slug. Use when the user wants to update a share they already created — e.g. 'fix the typo on the page I shared', 'update that demo with the new code'. The shareUrl stays the same; viewers who already loaded the page need to refresh.  Requires an edit token in ~/.qhs/shares.json (populated when qhs_share or the companion Claude Code skill created the share). If the slug is unknown, ask the user to paste their edit URL — the part after #edit= is the token.

editToken.description: Override the locally-stored edit token. Pass this if the user supplied a fresh edit URL.

name: qhs_edit
